verdict.rationale: Gladia's pre-recorded quickstart lists speaker diarization, which separates the speakers across the conversation, as a feature you can request through the API. Beyond that one line, nothing shows how it is enabled, how speaker labels appear on utterances in the transcript, or whether it works in live mode. Missing for 10: request parameter docs, per-utterance speaker-label output format, live/real-time diarization support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
